subject_line: An Author Spotlight for Afternoons That Tasted Like Love in Manila
email_body:
Hi Michelle,

It was a pleasure to come across Afternoons That Tasted Like Love in Manila, your twelfth book, released in July 2026. A collection of flash fiction and poetry about the memories, smells and streets of Manila, written after a great love was lost and a self rediscovered, is deeply moving.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

Your July 2026 release is a collection of flash fiction and poetry shaped by Manila memories, scents and streets, which feels perfect for visual storytelling. If a short trailer or a few promotional reels for this book is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It would be entirely optional, and it can sit alongside the Spotlight or stand on its own.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Afternoons That Tasted Like Love in Manila best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
The Author Ledger
